packageRules.description: dappertable is a runtime dependency, so it must cut a release. The shared python preset only puts pep621 and dockerfile updates under the dev- prefix, and this pin is tracked by the custom.regex manager below, so without this rule it lands on renovate/tnoff-dappertable-1.x and ci.yml's bump-version job (gated on renovate/dev-*) is skipped.

The discord-core pin is how a core release reaches the pods, so bumping it must cut a release for each pod. Same reason as dappertable above: the pin is tracked by a custom.regex manager, which the shared python preset leaves without the dev- prefix, so bump-version (gated on renovate/dev-*) would be skipped.

customManagers.description: Track the dappertable tarball pin (pep621 cannot version a plain archive URL)

Track the discord-core pin shared by all six pods (pep621 cannot version a plain archive URL). The repo carries one tag series per package (core-v, gateway-v, ...), so extractVersionTemplate keeps only core-v tags. Every pod carries the identical URL, so Renovate raises ONE PR touching all of them, which is what tests/cli/_package_pins.py requires.
